checks.detail: Confirmed install-rig opens an Orca terminal
First-run installer downloaded OpenRig 0.7.13 in an actual Orca terminal
Node + tmux + real SQLite verified; installation completes without agent/auth
Confirmed start-daemon opens an Orca terminal
Isolated loopback daemon starts with no kernel or agents
Confirmed example-demo opens an Orca terminal
Plugin-created Builder and Reviewer terminal seats are running
Compact read-only native whoami observations resolve the terminal demo relationship without full graph, token or transcript requests
Real CLI projected rig/pod identities for both terminal-only seats from the explicitly configured private instance
Both example roles rendered prerecorded simulation output in actual Orca PTYs
Closing Orca views leaves both tmux seats running
Explicit plugin stop action stops only the recorded terminal demo
Confirmed example-claude opens an Orca terminal
Confirmed example-codex opens an Orca terminal
Real OpenRig froze both provider templates and displayed declarations/unknowns independently of mutable source files
Both single-provider RigSpecs and all AgentSpecs validated by real OpenRig; no real agent seats launched
The frozen-bundle confirmation program previewed and launched two real terminal-only seats; no model runtime was used
Disconnected inventory seats render in actual left-to-right and top-to-bottom coordinate order, not merely matching dropdown values
An unchanged observation preserves SVG/node identity, zoom, selection and an open tooltip; stale markers update without redrawing
Native UTF-8 hover/focus previews remain inert and outside SVG; click/Enter/Space and mouseleave (even while focused) dismiss immediately, and late reads cannot reopen them
The HTML visibility gate conservatively pauses a same-origin frame hidden with display:none or visibility:hidden; no private Orca event is assumed
One native HTML panel captured in light/dark; its two-view navigation, inline diagram selection and internal walkthrough exercised in the isolated browser without a worker bridge
Fixture, daemon, plugin, terminals and profile-owned desktop/terminal-host processes cleaned up

unverified: Actual provider authentication, paid-agent startup and model work
Real-agent instruction delivery and durable-task processing
Other OS/runtime versions and ARM64 hardware rerun
